title: 빨간 우산
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop Funk-Pop. Clean electric guitar opens with a syncopated, percussive riff using 16th-note scratches and double-stops. A mid-tempo groove at 105 BPM in the key of G Major features a punchy electric bass playing a slap-and-pop line that follows the kick drum. The drums consist of a tight, dry snare and a crisp hi-hat playing 16th-note patterns. Male vocals are delivered in a rhythmic, melodic style with occasional breathy textures and subtle pitch slides. A bright brass section enters with staccato stabs on the off-beats. The production is polished with light compression on the vocals and a short room reverb on the snare.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[syncopated clean electric guitar riff with 16th-note scratches]
[slap bass enters]

[Verse 1]
[rhythmic male vocals]
어디쯤 가고 있을까
비가 내리고 있어
밤이 저물어가 [bass slides down]
횡단보도 건너편에
빨간 우산이 보여
발이 멈춰 심장이
제멋대로 뛰는 거야 너의 리듬 없는 데 [brass stabs]
몸이 먼저 알아
빨간 우산
